name: blood-moon-countdown
author: Takaro
description: 7 Days to Die helper commands and optional Discord replies that tell players how many in-game days remain until the next blood moon/horde night. The interval, first horde day, console command, manual fallback day, Discord triggers, and player-facing messages are editable in module config.

hordeIntervalDays.description: How often blood moon/horde night happens, in in-game days. Vanilla is every 7 days.

firstHordeDay.description: The first blood moon day in the cycle. Vanilla is day 7.

timeConsoleCommand.description: Console command used to read current 7D2D game time. The output must include the current day, such as 'Day 12'.

manualCurrentDay.description: Manual current day used when parseConsoleTime is disabled, or as fallback when allowManualFallbackOnParseFailure is enabled.

allowManualFallbackOnParseFailure.description: When enabled, use manualCurrentDay if the console command fails or cannot be parsed. Leave disabled to avoid stale countdowns when live time lookup breaks.

parseConsoleTime.description: When enabled, /bloodmoon and /day7 run the console command and parse the current day. Disable to use manualCurrentDay only.

hordeTodayText.description: Text used for {daysUntilText} when the next horde day is today.

daysUntilText.description: Text used for {daysUntilText} when the horde is in the future. Supports {daysUntil}.

parseErrorMessage.default: I couldn't read the current game day. Ask an admin to check the blood-moon-countdown module config or set manualCurrentDay.
parseErrorMessage.description: Player-facing message when console time parsing fails and no manual fallback can be used.

includeConsoleOutputInLogs.description: Log the raw console output when parsing fails. Useful while tuning timeConsoleCommand.

discordTriggers.description: Discord message triggers that make the module reply in Discord. Requires the discordBloodmoon hook to be configured with a Discord channel.

bloodmoon.description: Show how many in-game days remain until the next blood moon/horde night.
bloodmoon.helpText: Usage: /bloodmoon — shows current day, next horde day, and days remaining.

day7.helpText: Usage: /day7 — shows how many days remain until the next blood moon/horde night.

discordBloodmoon.description: Reply in Discord when someone types a configured trigger such as !bloodmoon or !day7.
